name: OVHcloud

name: Palo Alto Networks

name: Roche
notes: F. Hoffmann-La Roche / Roche Holding AG (ROG.SW), Basel - whole group. Market cap $352.10B covers BOTH classes: 106,691,000 bearer shares plus 702,562,700 non-voting participation certificates (the Genussscheine were exchanged 1:1 for participation certificates trading as ROP from 2026-03-17), about 809.25M securities. Cross-check: 809.25M x CHF 350.50 = CHF 283.6B, x 1.237 CHF/USD (2026-09-08) = about $351B, consistent. Disagreement noted: TradingEconomics shows CHF 243.21B, which equals only the 702.56M participation certificates and understates the company - not used. Headcount 112,774 is the Roche Group total at end of 2025.
source: companiesmarketcap.com (Roche market cap); Roche Annual Report 2025 (group headcount)

name: Rolls-Royce

source: Rolls-Royce Holdings plc Annual Report 2025 (headcount); stockanalysis.com (LON:RR market cap)

name: Silicon Catalyst
notes: Semiconductor startup incubator/accelerator in Santa Clara, founded 2014 - not an operating company and not listed, so no market cap exists; valuation left blank deliberately. Headcount also left blank: the firm states no team size, and its own team page lists roughly 41 named managing partners, international partners and board directors rather than employees. Aggregator figures conflict wildly (LinkedIn 2-10; ContactOut 93; gritt.io/others 214-215, which appear to count the mentor and advisor network) and none is a usable employee total.

name: TME
